standard.summary: 从底模和微调模型的差分中提取 LoRA。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Extracts a LoRA from the difference between a base model and a finetuned one.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 从底模和微调模型的差分中提取 LoRA。大模型会比较慢，建议先小 rank 测试。

advanced_en.principle: Extracts a LoRA from the difference between the base model and a fine-tuned model. Large models are slow; start with a small rank to test.
